items.item_text: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications, required
Clerical experience in an acute hospital environment, preferred

The Administrative Clinical Care Partner is a professional caregiver who assumes responsibility and accountability under the direct supervision of the Registered Nurse and supports the unit by maintaining inventory to include chart supplies, patient educational supplies, and daily unit supplies. Performs basic patient care skills for our Telemetry/Oncology/Stroke population, follows infection control practices, assists in transfers, and transports patients before and after procedures. Additionally, tasks include cleaning and preparing gurneys. ACCP's within the scope of practice assist with vital signs and transports patients ready for discharge under the discretion of the registered nurse. In addition, the ACCP's report any pertinent information to the Registered Nurse. Your shift may be variable to meet departmental needs.
Understanding of basic medical terminology and abbreviations, preferred
Ability to complete an 8-hour computer data entry training course
Ability to perform all delegated nursing and PT/OT/RT assisted tasks
Ability to work efficiently and effectively with others
Skill in evaluating and reporting emergent patient/unit information
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment under a heavy workload
